retained_adaptations.reason: Case-owned warning metadata replaces Native SAVE flag; warns once/context not once/process; no truncation/dedup/data change.
optional::value rejects missing forwarded scalar dimensions only when used; Native required dummy is absent at that same reached boundary.
Explicit fatal for Native unallocated defs unconditional deallocation on empty/comment-only registry.
C++ vector strings use common maximum width, matching existing bridge pack_strings contract and resulting Native fixed CHARACTER array.
Existing to_host_space packs Kokkos possibly strided/device values before typed C pointer API; explicit Native source start/count supplied.
Existing grid class retains execution-space heights; explicit transfer at host statistics/remapping boundaries. Existing remap API handles lower execution staging.
Native OMP critical is represented by current supported sequential host-call stream; no concurrent host I/O or global lock added.
Vendor-specific Fortran allocation/IOSTAT codes replaced by nonzero portable parser/allocation statuses; fatal/nonfatal control flow retained.
